primitives.name: Quarterback Efficiency While Accounting for Drops
primitives.verbatim_quote: NEW COMPOSITE METRIC: "Quarterback Efficiency while Accounting for Drops" = sum of air EPA & expected YAC EPA minus actual EPA (2026).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'EPA': 'Expected Points Added (dimensionless)', 'air EPA': 'Air Expected Points Added (dimensionless)', 'expected YAC EPA': 'Expected Yards After Catch EPA (dimensionless)', 'actual EPA': 'Actual Expected Points Added (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: All 36 QBs have consistent drop data availability and EPA modeling fidelity.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When drop count exceeds threshold, leading to negative efficiency scores.

layer2.mapping: GSI Bayesian update of QB rankings using composite metric as likelihood function; GSE state transition uses updated QB efficiency for play-calling optimization.

primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'Run Defense Grade': 'Normalized score out of 100 (dimensionless)', 'Opponent Run Success Rate': 'Fraction of runs that succeed (dimensionless)'}

primitives.name: RB Ranking Candidate Threshold
primitives.verbatim_quote: Thread: Warren (RB16), Tuten (RB17), Aaron Jones (RB18) = outside-top-12 RB1 candidates.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'RB Rank Score': 'Composite ranking score (dimensionless)', 'opp share': 'Opposition share of snaps (fraction)', 'yds/touch': 'Average yards per touch (yards/touch)', 'α, β': 'Weighting coefficients (dimensionless)'}
